Late afternoon on the green banks of the Jordan River, reeds and tall trees, warm gold light on the water. Rabbi Yochanan, a strikingly handsome scholar in his forties with a short dark beard and gentle eyes, in a simple white linen tunic, stands waist-deep in the calm river, eyes closed, peaceful, water around him catching the light. The same stretch of the Jordan River. Reish Lakish, a huge, powerful man in his thirties with a wild black beard and broad shoulders, in a rough dark tunic and a leather belt, is caught mid-leap from a high rock on the bank, flying toward the water in one huge bound. Below, Rabbi Yochanan, a strikingly handsome scholar in his forties with a short dark beard and gentle eyes, in a simple white linen tunic, turns in the river, startled. Spray, gold light, deep blue shadows, drama.
